verdict.rationale: cubic documents a `cubic.yaml` at the repo root that acts as the source of truth for AI review behavior, ignore patterns (path filters), PR descriptions and custom agents. An org-wide `cubic-config` repository is also supported, and community discussion confirms plain-English rules live in the codebase. missing for 10: explicit per-path instruction scoping, named review profiles, a detailed schema reference, hands-on corroboration of the YAML config working.
